[IDAT.3.3.9] **Float model.** A float a JSON value holds is finite
([LGRA.5.8.10]). `ds_json_new_float` must refuse a `v` that is `±Inf` or a NaN
with `DS_ERR_JSON_NONFINITE` and leave `*out` `NULL`, and `ds_json_parse` must
refuse a number literal past the largest finite double with `DS_ERR_PARSE`, as
malformed text. So no tree an integrator parses or builds holds a non-finite
float, and none reaches the engine as a `DS_SLOT_JSON` slot value or a call's
response. `ds_json_serialize` **must** still refuse a tree holding one with
`DS_ERR_JSON_NONFINITE` ([LDET.3.2.7]), which libds's own writers rely on and
no `libds.h` caller meets.
